create_ovis2_processor: create an Ovis2Processor instance with image_processor and tokenizer for multimodal image-text input
call_processor_with_images: call the Ovis2Processor with images and text containing <image> tokens to produce batched input features
expand_image_tokens_in_text: expand <image> placeholders in text strings into structured IMG_ATOM grids with row and column separators
batch_decode_token_outputs: batch decode token ids produced by the processor using the underlying tokenizer's batch_decode method
decode_single_token_sequence: decode a single sequence of token ids into a text string using the underlying tokenizer's decode method
